system.description:
FLOURISH Action 1 AP

Make two unarmed Strikes. If both hit the same creature, apply DR, resistance and weakness only once. Apply your multiple attack penalty to the Strikes normally.

Be aware that you may only inflict one critical injury when using this ability, although you still gain additional critical damage from both strikes.

Automated: press Use: 1 AP (a Flourish, once a turn), then two Strikes with your fists or a Monastic weapon, each at your current multiple attack penalty. A creature hit twice meets its DR once, on the first hit; resistance and weakness are applied to each hit, which is the same as once on the total. After one critical injury, a later critical keeps its bonus dice and rolls no injury. If your Disciplined Flurry is ready and you have a reaction, you are asked whether to use it for a third Strike.
